name: The Impossible Show
flavor: The whole tent disappears. In its place: whatever you need everyone to believe is standing here instead - a burning building, a bottomless pit, an army that was never hired.
description: You remake a piece of the world. A 60-foot cube within range fills with a fully realised illusory environment — sight, sound, temperature, even scent — and it can be anything you can picture: a collapsed tunnel, a wall of roaring fire, a chasm where the floor used to be, a cheering crowd of a hundred phantom performers. It needs no concentration and holds for the duration while you do whatever else you like. It is still an image: it deals no damage, supports no weight, and stops nothing that does not care what it sees.
narration: The tent is gone. In its place is a rockfall, or a fire, or a drop into nothing — cold on your face, loud in your ears, entirely in the way, and nobody caught inside it can think straight. It holds until one person stops and really looks, and then there was never anything there at all.
sheetSummary: Once per combat. Action, 120 ft, 60-ft cube, costs 3 Phantasm, up to 10 minutes, no concentration. Deals no damage and supports no weight. Its four standing effects and its one-off dramatic moment are listed below.

options.name: Blocks sight
options.effect: Line of sight cannot be traced through the cube.

options.name: Difficult terrain
options.effect: The whole area is difficult terrain — nobody walks briskly through a rockfall they believe in.

options.name: Nobody thinks straight inside
options.effect: Every creature inside the cube has disadvantage on every attack roll, ability check and saving throw it makes. This applies to your allies too: place it as a hazard to work around, not a blanket to fight under.

options.name: Seeing through it ends everything
options.effect: A creature can spend its action to study the illusion and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}; a creature that shoves through it makes that check as part of the movement. On ANY success the illusion collapses immediately and entirely, for every creature at once.

options.name: The dramatic moment (once, bonus action)
options.effect: The phantom army charges, the fire roars up, the floor gives way. Every creature of your choice inside the cube or within 10 feet of it makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or is frightened of it until the end of its next turn and, if it has a reaction available, uses that reaction to move as far from the illusion as its speed allows.
